label: Updated at 8 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Wyndham Clark leads U.S. Open
items.text: Wyndham Clark finished the U.S. Open at -4, holding a one-shot lead over Sam Burns (-3) and three shots clear of Tom Kim (-1).

items.headline: Zach Johnson leads senior major
items.text: Zach Johnson leads the Kaulig Companies Champions Championship by six shots at 15-under 265, securing his first PGA Tour Champions major and a spot in next year's Players Championship.

items.headline: Haeran Ryu repeats at Evian
items.text: Haeran Ryu leads the Amundi Evian Championship in a playoff over Brooke Henderson for her second major in three weeks, after closing with a clutch two-putt birdie on the first extra hole.
